values.note: Booking site, Oct 2026 to Jun 2027: River Run's 23 non-electric sites (27-49) $24.99 a night ($29.99 a night on a Friday-Saturday stay); its 26 electric/water sites (1-26) $44.99, weeknights and weekends alike.
